The company targets mid-single-digit growth for 2025–26, anchoring its positioning in premium and luxury lifestyle segments rather than competing head-to-head with mass-market or athletic giants. RL is assigned a "narrow economic moat" derived from powerful brand equity, lifestyle positioning, and pricing power that transcends traditional apparel cycles. **Threats from Rivals & Execution Risks**
RL’s primary competitive peers include PVH Corp., Tapestry, Inc., Capri Holdings, Nike, and Lululemon.
